Are the audit artifacts any use?

/home/bjieyong/aiverify2/auditing/cv_annotation/audit_coco500 scored against planted errors: missing images had boxes deleted, wrong images had boxes relabelled. Each perturbed image's clean original is in the same set. Review budget = 50 images (the length of review_list.csv).

Sanity checks

  • Images: 500 (450 clean, 25 missing, 25 wrong); every perturbed image has its clean source in the set.
  • Planted boxes: 81 parsed, 81 in the log (ok)
  • Shuffled-score control: AUC 0.524 (expect about 0.5)
  • review_list.csv (50 images: 28 clean, 11 missing, 11 wrong) matches the top 50 of all_ranked.csv
  • Detector training split: 0 of 50 perturbed images are copies of training images; 450 clean images were held out (val).

Verdict per method

Suggestion: keep if AUC (any error) ≥ 0.75 and the paired Δ is positive; drop if AUC < 0.6 or the paired Δ ≤ 0; otherwise down-weight. These thresholds are rough rules of thumb, not tuned.
